_about: Keyboard shortcuts, our own notes (FL 20 and later unless fl_versions says otherwise). An entry's 3rd element {verify: true} = not confirmed on a real FL; {fl_versions: {min, max}} = only in those versions. Shortcuts can be changed or differ with keyboard layouts.

cards.title: Window shortcuts (F-keys)
cards.summary: F-keys open/close FL's main windows. Press again to hide the window.
shortcuts: Rename the selected item (channel, mixer track, pattern)
tips: Detach a window from FL's main frame (window menu > Detached) to put it on a second monitor.

cards.title: Transport and recording shortcuts
cards.summary: Play, record and the recording helpers on FL's toolbar.
shortcuts: Switch between pattern and song mode
Wait for input: recording starts when you play the first note
Blend recording (add notes instead of replacing)
Typing keyboard to piano (play notes with the computer keyboard)
tips: With 'typing keyboard to piano' on, many letter shortcuts are taken by notes - turn it off if a shortcut seems dead.

cards.title: File and export shortcuts
shortcuts: Save new version (adds a number to the file name)
Undo (older FL: toggles undo/redo of the last step)
Step back through the undo history
tips: Ctrl+N before a risky change gives you a numbered copy to go back to.

cards.title: Piano roll shortcuts
cards.summary: Tools and edits in the piano roll (focus the piano roll first).
shortcuts: Paint tool (drag to paint many notes)
Quick legato (stretch notes to the next one)
Move selected notes by an octave
Move selected notes by a semitone
tips: Ghost notes of other channels: piano roll menu > View > Ghost channels.

cards.title: Playlist shortcuts
cards.summary: Tools and edits in the playlist (focus the playlist first).
shortcuts: Insert / delete space at the selected time range
tips: Double-click a clip to open what it plays (pattern in the piano roll/channel rack, audio clip settings).

cards.title: Channel rack shortcuts
cards.summary: Working with channels in the channel rack.
shortcuts: Move the selected channel(s) up / down
Route the selected channel(s) to a free mixer track
tips: Each channel's 'Track' number box (left of its name) is the mixer track it plays through.

cards.title: Mixer shortcuts
cards.summary: Selecting, naming and routing mixer tracks.
shortcuts: Route the selected channel rack channel(s) to the selected mixer track
Route selected channels to consecutive mixer tracks starting at the selected one
Routing menu (sidechain to this track, route to this track only)
Arm the selected track for audio recording
tips: The small arrow at the bottom of each mixer track shows / sets where the selected track sends audio.

cards.title: Mouse tricks on knobs and sliders
cards.summary: How FL's knobs respond to the mouse and modifier keys.
shortcuts: Knob menu: create automation clip, link to controller, type in value, reset
tips: The hint bar (top left of FL) shows a control's name and value while you hover it.
